nodes.label: Battle-cursor Project
nodes.rationale: PvP browser game for up to 8 players drawing to prompts, applying debuffs, graded by Groq AI; positioned as portfolio project plus Habr article.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture (urls-views-serializers-services-repositories-models)
nodes.rationale: Strictly enforced layering; cache logic lives only in the services layer; most apps have config.py for constants except game/ where config.py was deleted and debuff constants live in debuffs.py.

nodes.label: Coins and Rating Economy
nodes.rationale: Coins = score x 10, accumulated in Redis per round and synced to DB only after game_over so no coins are spent or credited mid-game; winner (1st place) gets +1 rating. Avoids partial DB writes during an active game.

nodes.label: Groq API (grading + prompt generation)
nodes.rationale: Model meta-llama/llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct-fp8; grades drawings 0.1-5.0 and generates round prompts in Russian.

nodes.label: JWTAuthMiddleware (WebSocket auth)
nodes.rationale: Decodes JWT from query string into scope[user] for WebSocket connections; unauthorized connections closed with code 4001.

nodes.label: Null-effects in Game.tsx (state-based debuffs)
nodes.rationale: Some debuffs (chill, weight, quickly, palette, disco, transparency, brightness, blur, fog) have no dedicated component and are implemented directly in Game.tsx via useEffect/state and cursor lerp handlers.

nodes.label: Redis Key Schema
nodes.rationale: DB 0 for channel layer + Celery broker, DB 1 for django-redis cache. Uses cache.iter_keys (SCAN-based, non-blocking) instead of cache.keys (O(N) KEYS); atomic add+incr for the submitted counter; coin keys deleted only via transaction.on_commit so they survive DB rollback.

nodes.label: grading_lock (Redis mutex for grade_round)
nodes.rationale: round:{id}:grading_lock TTL=120s prevents double execution of grade_round when both the all-submitted path and the 65s force_grade_round safety net fire.

nodes.label: game_state_sync (reconnect state payload)
nodes.rationale: On connect() during an active game the consumer sends full game state (round, prompt, time_left, used_debuffs, player_scores, round_history) so a reconnecting player resumes seamlessly; also cancels the pending offline kick.

nodes.label: Debuff System
nodes.rationale: 56 debuffs across 5 rarities applied via WS debuff_apply; one-time use per round (used_debuff TTL=70s), target blocked while debuff_active is set, free of coin cost. All debuff state cleared in start_round before each round.

nodes.label: Mirror (passive reflect debuff)
nodes.rationale: Backend-level passive: if the target's cursor contains mirror, the debuff is reflected onto the sender; is_reflected=True flag prevents infinite reflection recursion.

nodes.label: Canvas Protection
nodes.rationale: Canvas.protections lists debuff_ids it blocks; protection triggers once per round per debuff type (protection_used key TTL=70s), sending debuff_blocked instead of applying the effect.

nodes.label: LEGENDARY Debuffs (5s block set)
nodes.rationale: 10 legendary debuffs (questions, exam, weighting, weapons, rickroll, disco, transparency, brightness, roulette, dvd) block the target for a fixed 5s TTL instead of the debuff's own duration; the set is hardcoded in consumers.py handle_debuff_apply.

nodes.label: Game Lifecycle (waiting -> in_progress -> finished)
nodes.rationale: Lobby via REST + WS, host-only game_start, N rounds (N = player count, max 8) of 60s each, grading per round, final aggregation in game_over, then Server deleted and Game/drawings cleaned up on delayed timers.

nodes.label: Fix: delete_game vs cleanup_drawings race condition
nodes.rationale: Both tasks originally had countdown=60; delete_game cascades Round deletion so cleanup_drawings could find no rounds. Fixed by staggering: cleanup_drawings at t+30s, delete_game at t+120s, giving 90s of margin.
nodes.norm_label: fix: delete_game vs cleanup_drawings race condition

nodes.label: Known bug: Redis coin write inside transaction.atomic
nodes.rationale: cache.set of coin key happens inside transaction.atomic in grade_round (tasks.py:205-208); on DB rollback Redis is already updated, and with max_retries=3 coins could double. Deliberately not fixed for MVP; planned move under on_commit.
nodes.norm_label: known bug: redis coin write inside transaction.atomic
